name: Claude Blog
description:
AI-powered blog creation and optimization skill with 20 commands, 4 specialized agents, and 5-category 100-point
scoring. Write, rewrite, analyze, and optimize blog posts for Google rankings (December 2025 Core Update, E-E-A-T)
and AI citations (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews). Includes persona-driven writing, fact-checking against cited
sources, keyword cannibalization detection, CMS taxonomy sync (WordPress, Shopify, Ghost, Strapi, Sanity),
NotebookLM source-grounded research, Gemini TTS audio narration, AI image generation, editorial calendars,
SERP-informed outlines, JSON-LD schema markup, and multi-platform content repurposing.
longDescription:
Ships **32 skills** and **5 agents**.

- **Skills** (32): `blog` (Full-lifecycle blog engine with 31 sub-skills, 12 content templates, 5-category 100-point scoring, and 5 specialized agents), `blog-analyze` (Audit and score blog posts on a 5-category 100-point scoring system covering content quality, SEO optimization, E-E-A-T signals,…), `blog-audio` (Generate audio narration of blog posts using Google Gemini TTS), `blog-audit` (Full-site blog health assessment scanning all blog files for quality scores, orphan pages, topic cannibalization, stale content, and…), `blog-brand` (Establish durable brand and voice context for cross-skill consumption), `blog-brief` (Generate detailed content briefs for blog posts with target keywords, content outlines, competitive analysis, recommended statistics, image and…), `blog-calendar` (Generate editorial calendars for blogs with topic clusters, publishing schedules, content decay detection, freshness update plans, seasonal opportunities,…), `blog-cannibalization` (Detect keyword cannibalization across blog posts by extracting primary keywords from titles and headings, clustering semantically similar targets,…), and 24 more
- **Agents** (5): `blog-researcher` (Research specialist for blog content), `blog-reviewer` (Quality assessment specialist for blog posts), `blog-seo` (SEO optimization specialist for blog posts), `blog-translator` (Specialized translation and localization agent for blog content), `blog-writer` (Content generation specialist for blog posts)

Installs with `claude plugin install claude-blog@claude-community` from `AgriciDaniel/claude-blog`.
